$historyId..validate:
newData.hasChildren(['champion', 'finishedAt', 'level', 'mode', 'name', 'participantCount'])
          && newData.child('champion').isString()
          && newData.child('champion').val().length <= 30
          && newData.child('name').isString()
          && newData.child('name').val().length <= 50
          && newData.child('level').val().matches(/^(easy|medium|hard|master)$/)
          && newData.child('mode').val().matches(/^(groups|knockout|league)$/)
          && newData.child('participantCount').isNumber()
          && newData.child('participantCount').val() >= 2
          && newData.child('participantCount').val() <= 64

$resultId..validate:
newData.hasChildren(['game', 'playerName', 'createdAt', 'score', 'won', 'mode', 'sourceSetId', 'sourceSetName', 'details'])
            && newData.child('game').isString()
            && newData.child('game').val() == $game
            && newData.child('playerName').isString()
            && newData.child('playerName').val().length >= 1
            && newData.child('playerName').val().length <= 50
            && newData.child('score').isNumber()
            && newData.child('won').isBoolean()
            && newData.child('mode').isString()
            && newData.child('mode').val().length >= 1
            && newData.child('mode').val().length <= 30
            && newData.child('sourceSetId').isString()
            && newData.child('sourceSetId').val().length <= 100
            && newData.child('sourceSetName').isString()
            && newData.child('sourceSetName').val().length <= 150
            && newData.child('details').isString() == false
